content: Temporal documents deterministic command sequences, recorded external/random/time inputs and replay testing against existing histories after code changes. Tapestry-specific inference: persist AI outcomes, define numeric/time/order semantics and retained plugin artifacts, bind snapshots to history and behavior identity, and distinguish readable state from execution with missing behavior. Sources: https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-definition https://docs.temporal.io/develop/safe-deployments
